### The Greatest Discovery
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/the-greatest-discovery.html
Passage: Matthew 2:11
Points:
- Natural deduction and general revelation are not enough to bring people to Christ.
- God uses the Scriptures to direct seekers to the living Word, His Son.
- Arriving before Jesus leaves no room for human arrogance or pride.
- Encountering the King demands a posture of awe, humility, and wholehearted worship.
- Grasping the gospel means laying down our possessions, time, and lives before Him daily.

### The Wise Men Rejoice
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wise-men-rejoice
Passage: Matthew 2:7–10
Points:
- Common nativity traditions add embellishments that the biblical narrative does not state.
- God guided Gentile outsiders to confirm their mission and fulfill Old Testament prophecy.
- The arrival of the star filled the magi with overwhelming joy.
- The Father ensures that His Son receives glory in spite of hostile opposition.
- Believers are challenged to honor Christ rather than resist His sovereign reign.
